title: fix(plugin-grid): name bulk-confirm records by the declared nameField, never a derived field
body:
Fixes #13107
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The bulk-action confirm step lists each affected record by the object's declared `nameField`. Before this change, when no column of the view showed that field, the step listed another text field in its place. Measured on HotCRM's All Contacts list, it showed job titles instead of contact names.

Two halves, both in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`:

- **Harvest (`ObjectGrid` `getSelectFields`).** The grid's own `$select` now asks for the object's declared `nameField`. It is read through `declaredNameField`, the resolver's single spelling of that pointer. A formula field is requested by name, because the server serves formulas. It is fetched, not drawn: it joins the projection, not the columns. It goes through the same two gates as the grid's other extra fields: `isProjectableField` (the object must declare it) and `passesProjectionGate` (the viewer may read it). It joins the existing union, so a `nameField` that is already a column is sent once. This is the projection a standalone `object-grid` sends, and the one every group row page of a server-grouped grid sends. The measured All Contacts view is grouped by account (`grouping.fields: crm_account`), so that is the path its rows take.
- **Floor (`BulkActionDialog` confirm step).** A new module-local `affectedRecordName` decides the name. An object with no declared `nameField` keeps `getRecordDisplayName`'s full ladder, unchanged. For an object that declares one, the step uses the declared value, or the resolver's own `Record #ID` floor when the row lacks it. The derive steps (4 and 4b) are never reached for such an object. Two cases leave the row without the value: the server did not answer it, or the viewer may not read it.

No change to `getRecordDisplayName`'s global ladder in `@object-ui/core` (triage ruling). Nothing is added to the package entry: no export, prop or type member.

## Pins (`packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkConfirmNameField-13107.test.tsx`)

Each pin drives the real ObjectGrid and BulkActionDialog. The data source honours `$select` the way a server does: a row carries the selected keys only.

- (a) Formula `full_name` as `nameField`, with columns `first_name` / `last_name` / `title`. The `$select` carries `full_name`, the confirm step lists `John Smith` and `Marcus Reed`, and no column header is drawn for it.
- (a) The same object on a server-grouped grid: every group row page's `$select` carries `full_name`.
- (b) The server leaves `full_name` off the answer: the step lists `Record #c1` and `Record #c2`, never the job titles.
- (b) The viewer may not read `full_name`: it is not requested, and the step lists `Record #ID`.
- CONTROL (c): a `nameField` that is a column (the lead list shape) is sent once and listed as before.
- CONTROL (c): an object with no `nameField` asks for nothing more and keeps today's derive ladder. It lists the titles, as before.

## Ablations (one-off, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in the objectstack checkout; no permanent test)

Each mutation landed on disk with the anchor count going 1 to 0. Each was restored and checked: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

1. Drop the harvest (`...nameFields` removed from `extraFields`). Blob `c025fe82f5a1` became `49fa09861016`. 3 of 6 went red: both (a) pins and the first (b) pin, because that pin asserts `full_name` in `$select`. Restored to `c025fe82f5a1`, the HEAD blob.
2. Drop the floor (the `affectedRecordName` condition forced to the full ladder). Blob `15c5e833e1ec` became `62e734d67541`. Both (b) pins went red, and each received `VP of Engineering` and `Director of Commercial Systems`. That is the card's symptom, reproduced. Restored to `15c5e833e1ec`, the HEAD blob.

## Gates (final head `0d08662299`; source last changed at `85d07587eb`, later commits are the test file and the changeset)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the new test is in that program by `--listFilesOnly`): exit 0 on `0d08662299`.
- Targeted vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, run under the shared lock: the new file passes 6/6 on `0d08662299`. The families that touch these files ran on `85d07587eb`: 69 files, 1771 tests passed. That set is every plugin-grid test mentioning `$select` or the resolver, plus every test anywhere naming `ObjectGrid.tsx` or `BulkActionDialog`. The full `packages/plugin-grid/` directory is declared to CI.
- `eslint` on the three changed source and test files: 0 errors. The warnings are `no-explicit-any` in the test file, the same style as the precedent `bulkConfirmRecordTitles-12332` test.
- Battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-presence` all exit 0. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with `no-artifact`, because the workspace is not fully built. This is a known state of main and is recorded, not acted on.

## Acceptance notes

- **The other projection, outside this card's file surface.** An UNGROUPED list view is fetched by `plugin-list`'s `ListView`, which hands the rows to the grid. Its `$select` harvest has no arm for the declared `nameField`. On such a list, a `nameField` that is not a column now reads as `Record #ID` in the confirm step, not as a wrong name, but it is still not the name. The repair is a single `addSpeculative` call for the declared `nameField` in that harvest. `ListView` already has the matching arms for `rowColor` and `referenceVia`. That is plugin-list, outside the claim, so it is reported to the PM seat and not done here.
- `changeset`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.
